{{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Dragon| type2=Ground| trainername=Professor Sycamore| pokemonname=Garchomp| jtrainername=プラターヌ博士| jpokemonname=ガブリアス| tmtrainername=Dr. Platane| tmpokemonname=Gaburias| image=[[File:Sycamore Garchomp.png|250px]]| caption=Professor Sycamore's Garchomp| location=[[Lumiose City]]| gender=FemaleConfirmed via [[List of Pokémon with gender differences|gender differences]].|| ability=Unknown| evolution=2| epnum=XY002| epname=Lumiose City Pursuit!| firstevoep=XY002| firstevonametiming=Prior to| firstevoname=Lumiose City Pursuit!| numeps1=an unknown amount of| numeps2=an unknown amount of| firststagename=Gible| secondstagename=Gabite| prevonum=443 f| evo1num=444 f| evo2num=445 f| secondevoep=XY002| secondevonametiming=Prior to| secondevoname=Lumiose City Pursuit!| current=[[Party|With Professor Sycamore]]| java1=Unknown| enva1=Unknown| java2=Unknown| enva2=Unknown| java3=Unknown| }} '''Professor Sycamore's Garchomp''' (Japanese: '''プラターヌ博士のガブリアス''' ''Dr. Platane's Gaburias'') is {{an|Professor Sycamore}}'s only known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==In animation== ===History=== ====Pre-series==== [[File:Alain Gible.png|250px|left|thumb|Gible being found by Alain]] In ''[[XY068|Garchomp's Mega Bond!]]'', it was revealed that {{p|Garchomp}}, as a {{p|Gible}}, rampaged through [[Lumiose City]], only to be stopped by Sycamore's assistant [[Alain]]. Alain took her to Sycamore's laboratory, where she then came to live. She gradually started to trust Sycamore and the other Pokémon at the lab, and after some time [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Gabite}} and finally into Garchomp, becoming the main test subject as he researched [[Mega Evolution]]. ===={{aniseries|XY}}==== Garchomp made her debut in ''[[XY002|Lumiose City Pursuit!]]'', when {{TRT}} attempted to capture {{AP|Froakie}}, and defended it from Team Rocket's device which then attached itself to her. This caused her severe pain resulting in her going on a rampage through Lumiose City and heading to the top of [[Prism Tower]]. [[File:Professor Sycamore and Garchomp.png|250px|thumb|Garchomp and Professor Sycamore]] Once there, she was carefully approached by {{Ash}} who refused to allow {{AP|Pikachu}} to use any moves against her since she couldn't help her behavior. Soon, with Ash and Froakie's help, the device was removed and Garchomp returned to her old self. In ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', Garchomp was by Professor Sycamore's side whilst there was a TV report about Alain's battle with Mega {{p|Rayquaza}}, [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{p|Groudon}}, and Primal {{p|Kyogre}}. In ''[[XY068|Garchomp's Mega Bond!]]'', Garchomp Mega Evolved into a Mega Garchomp thanks to a [[Garchompite]] that he found and a [[Key Stone]] that [[Meyer]] lent to him as Blaziken Mask. Garchomp was sent out to defend [[Mairin]] from a {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}'s {{p|Skorupi}} in ''[[XY132|A Towering Takeover!]]''. She later Mega Evolved and joined the fight against [[Team Flare]] in ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]''. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== In ''[[JN115|Curtain Up! Fight the Fights!]]'', Garchomp watched Alain's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Leon}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== As a Gible, she was a hostile and frightened Pokémon. Gible caused trouble at the lab until {{an|Professor Sycamore}} reached out to her. The Professor stayed calm, even after Gible bit him in defense, and she became relaxed in his company. As Gible [[Evolution|evolved]], she grew more relaxed and more socialable, interacting with [[Alain]] and the other Pokémon at the lab. By the time {{Ash}} first met her in ''[[XY002|Lumiose City Pursuit!]]'', Garchomp is shown to be a very gentle Pokémon, despite her fearsome appearance. She immediately showed her concern for {{AP|Froakie}} and seemed to recognize the urgency of the matter. She enjoys company, and happily allows others to pet her.
